card.name: Linking words in fill-to-line instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words like 'to' or 'in' right after an action verb phrase in step-by-step instructions, where a target level, mark or window comes next. Mostly syringe plunger and fill-line directions.

modes.label: Fill or pull to a mark
modes.description: The word 'to' after pulling a plunger or adding water, before a dose or fill line.
